name: This Moment
description: A retro LCD window over 70s chevron stripes: the time in rounded monoline digits, the weekday and the date. After BA | AXR9800.

steps.script:
project.appId = 1133671;
    await registerCustomFont({ name: 'saira-500.ttf', family: 'Saira Medium', format: 'truetype', ext: '.ttf', dataBase64: '' });
    const D = {"scene.png":"","colon.png":"","acolon.png":"","d_0.png":"","a_0.png":"","d_1.png":"","a_1.png":"","d_2.png":"","a_2.png":"","d_3.png":"","a_3.png":"","d_4.png":"","a_4.png":"","d_5.png":"","a_5.png":"","d_6.png":"","a_6.png":"","d_7.png":"","a_7.png":"","d_8.png":"","a_8.png":"","d_9.png":"","a_9.png":""};
    for (const [n, b] of Object.entries(D)) { const im = new Image(); im.src = 'data:image/png;base64,' + b; await im.decode();
      const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = im.width; c.height = im.height; c.getContext('2d').drawImage(im, 0, 0); addProjectImage('tm/' + n, c, {}); }
    await loadAllImages(); return Object.keys(D).length
const e = await addElement('IMG', { src: 'tm/scene.png' }); e.name = 'Scene'; e.src = 'tm/scene.png'; e.x = 0; e.y = 0; e.show = 'normal'; return 1
const n = project.elements.length; for (const i of [n - 3, n - 2, n - 1]) project.elements[i].name += ' Aod'; return 1
